correctness.rationale: PASS. For regular paperfolding p_n determined by odd(n) mod4, signed prefix height H(N) equals weight of the reflected binary Gray code N xor floor(N/2). Its reflected-half recursion proves all crossing Dyck intervals are [2^r-1,2^K-1] with lengths 2^K-2^r, 1<=r<K. For each such L, reflection of the two canonical intervals forces the only start residues a=2^r-1 or 2^K modulo 2^(K+1); odd-part invariance on the interior proves both residues always give Dyck factors. The two canonical words coincide only at L=2,4, and two starts per modulus give density 2^(-K) and exact dyadic prefix occurrence count 2^(M-K) for M>=K+1. Independently enumerated all Dyck intervals at finite levels 2..10 and verified exact residues and multiplicities; induction establishes all levels.
